Done. Wrote only `plans/sdd/V6-remediation/automated-closeout-run-map.md` (no source/test/build/git/release changes; all older reports, maps, history, and child files untouched; 304 inventory IDs preserved and not re-statused; canonical route `claude-opus-4-8` verified).

## Key blockers
1. **Source not frozen** — GC + offline-reader handoffs, producer review, and journal restart/crash + archived-reader integration are in flight; rollover stays default-off. No final candidate/package exists.
2. **Version identity conflict** — `core.Version = 0.1.0`, last tag `v0.2.0`, HEAD `v0.2.0-660-g06681ef`; `release-check --tag` requires tag == `core.Version`, so it fails today. Owner must pick the V6 version and reconcile.
3. **No CI run has ever executed** (1.17.19) — needs a runner/billing.
4. **Product-child race gate is unwired and unrun** — `test/e2e/race_instrumentation_test.go` exists but skips unless `QOMPACK_REQUIRE_CHILD_RACE=1`; no workflow sets it, and nightly `race-windows` excludes `test/e2e`, so the real child is uninstrumented.
5. **Human/model/native/registry obligations remain and cannot be automated** — 12 human UAT (all "not executed"), held-out model eval (`eval.LiveRunner` nil), macOS/windows-arm64 installed-host, registry-name/tag lookup, independent reader review, host native-Read parity + a pending user preference (V6-HOST-1).

## Actions (owners)
- Producer/GC/offline-reader/reviewer seats → land handoffs, then **freeze** one HEAD + record bundle hashes.
- Release owner → set `core.Version` to the intended tag, then `go run ./tools/devtool release-check --tag vX.Y.Z`.
- CI owner → first `ci.yml` run on the frozen HEAD; add a job setting `CGO_ENABLED=1 GOFLAGS=-race QOMPACK_REQUIRE_CHILD_RACE=1` for the child-race gate.
- Run the §A automated gates **once** on the frozen HEAD (integrated `go test ./... -timeout=30m` with structural tests named explicitly; packaged `test/fault|security|e2e|canary|platform|release|docs|integration`; store/cli maintenance; determinism; generated-doc drift + `licenses`; `qompack eval --json`; quiet bench; Linux `golang:1.26.6-bookworm` snapshot) — targeted reruns only for real failures, no per-row whole-tree reruns, every skip/failure recorded (no fake pass).
- Route §C human/env obligations to real permitted sessions/runners; record each unavailable target explicitly. No release/tag/publish/merge-to-develop until §A is green, blockers 1–4 clear, and §C is dispositioned.

The map has the exact commands, prerequisites, reusable focused-evidence caveats, owners, and the CI job list.
